Who We Are
Gateway FS, Inc. is a locally owned agricultural cooperative. Headquartered in Red Bud, Illinois, Gateway FS provides agronomy, Agri-Finance, energy, feed, structures, as well as grain marketing to our patrons. Over the years our name has changed but our standard of service has remained the same since 1931. Gateway FS is a leader in meeting producer needs in production agriculture and crop marketing.

Post-Harvest Equipment Maintenance: Tips to Avoid Downtime Next Season
During post-harvest, putting your equipment away is not the end of the maintenance cycle. Post-harvest starts next season's reliability plan.
Soybeans
Soybean Harvest Considerations
As wet weather conditions continue, multiple wetting and drying cycles beyond maturity results in soybean pod sutures breaking open and the seed falling to the soil surface. These soybeans are unable to be harvested and could be a reason for lower-than-expected yields.
Agronomy Services
Fall Nitrogen Application
Proper soil temperature combined with a forecast of downward-trending, assures you of the best chance of preserving your fall-applied anhydrous ammonia. Read about other useful practices that will help keep N available for next spring's crop.
